newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST BOURSE SUSPENDS TRADING IN CSOPAK.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST BOURSE SUSPENDS TRADING IN CSOPAK.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Tuesday it had suspended trading in the shares of Csopak Szovetkezeti Rt for Tuesday following a newspaper report about a new Csopak acquisition the company has not yet reported to the bourse.

"(The press report said) Csopak acquired a 98 percent stake in Pannonker Kereskedelmi es Ipari Rt indirectly, via Chance 96 Vagyonkezelo Kft, a unit in which Csopak holds a 49 percent share," the BSE said.
The BSE said it had asked Csopak to provide information about the press report, although Csopak, following the press report, had confirmed to the BSE it had put in a bid for Pannonker.

"The issuer (Csopak) informed the bourse ahead of the start of trading that Chance 96 Kft had submitted a bid to the state privatisation agency APV Rt to purchase the shares of Pannonker," the BSE's statement said.
"However, Csopak said it had not yet been informed in writing about APV Rt's decision and thus could not inform the bourse officially," it said.
On December 2, Csopak shares closed at 1,190 forints.
